privileged_info_for_vlm: The case must be created for the account 'NVIDIA Corporation' (which exists in the system). Required field values: Subject: 'Data pipeline latency spike after v4.1 upgrade'; Priority: 'High'; Status: 'New'; Type: 'Product'. The description must mention the v4.1 upgrade on February 8 and the latency increase from 200ms to 800-1200ms.
